title: Flat submodule in a universally exact sequence
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $0\to M_1\to M_2\to M_3\to0$ be a universally exact short exact sequence of $R$-modules, meaning that tensoring this sequence over $R$ with every $R$-module remains exact. If $M_2$ is flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $M_1$ is flat over $R$.

mathlib_searches.query: in a universally exact short exact sequence with flat middle module the submodule is flat
mathlib_searches.results: Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_exact and related exactness criteria; no theorem with universally exact sequence and flat submodule conclusion.
